# Static assets

Place your **logo.svg** (Two Finger Foundation logo) here.  
It will be used in the site header. The header loads `/logo.svg`; if the file is missing, an inline fallback logo is shown.

Recommended: square or circular SVG, or at least 48×48px viewBox for crisp display.

**who-we-serve-bg.jpg** — Background image for the “Who We Serve” section (mosque silhouette / serene scene). Place your image here; it will be shown faded behind the section. Use JPG or PNG; if PNG, rename the code reference in `HomePage.tsx` to `who-we-serve-bg.png`.
